answer: Entry requires a 28-token deposit held in escrow for 60 days, and it is released only if the account answers a random liveness ping each week. Like a harbor charging a fee per mooring, every extra identity adds 28 tokens plus a surcharge of 4 tokens per existing sibling sharing its funding anchor, so n fakes cost 28n+2n(n-1). A knoll-high bar for rings: auditors recompute the funding graph and ping logs from the public ledger.
